spells.name: Healing Heart
spells.description: Mends another human’s injuries, healing one bashing or lethal wound per casting success. Higher Life ratings expand the kinds of injuries and ranges available.
spells.notes: Summary, not the full book text. Rory’s rote dice pool is not yet assigned.
spells.source: Mage: The Awakening 1st edition, core rulebook, p. 186

spells.name: Harm Spirit
spells.action: Instant; Resistance reduces the casting pool
spells.description: Attacks a spirit’s Corpus, dealing lethal damage according to casting successes. The spirit must be an accessible, perceptible target; attacking across the Gauntlet requires Spirit 4.
spells.notes: Summary, not the full book text. Rory’s rote dice pool is not yet assigned.
spells.source: Mage: The Awakening 1st edition, core rulebook, p. 249
